proposed.explanation: The investor wants to add a fertilizer exporter for diversification with a 5-year horizon. Abu Qir Fertilizers (ABUK) is available at 76.21 EGP per share. We can use the verified basic earnings per share figure of 8.74 EGP for the nine months ended 30 September 2026. The investor has 40,000.00 EGP in cash and 200 shares of COMI worth 25,600.00 EGP (at 128.00 EGP per share), bringing the total portfolio value to 65,600.00 EGP. Buying 500 shares of ABUK costs 38,105.00 EGP, which fits within the available cash and leaves 1,895.00 EGP in cash. After this purchase, the total value of ABUK will be 38,105.00 EGP out of a total portfolio value of 65,600.00 EGP, representing approximately 58.09% of the portfolio. However, the rule states that after a buy, no single company may be more than half of the portfolio's total value. Therefore, we must buy fewer shares to comply with the 50% limit. Half of the total portfolio value (65,600.00 EGP) is 32,800.00 EGP. Since the investor already holds no ABUK, the maximum amount we can invest in ABUK is 32,800.00 EGP. At 76.21 EGP per share, 32,800.00 EGP allows for 430 shares (costing 32,770.30 EGP). We choose 430 shares to satisfy the 50% diversification limit. All financial figures used are verified, while ambiguous figures from the revenue, net profit, and percentage change rows have been marked unused.
